BILLING.cbl: This program operates within a utility or subscription-based billing domain, serving as a core batch processing component in the monthly invoicing workflow.
jcl/BILL01.jcl: This JCL job, named BILL01, is a monthly billing processing job that executes the BILLING program to generate customer invoices.
application: This application is a monthly billing processing system designed to automate the generation of customer invoices within a utility or subscription-based billing domain. It operates as a batch processing solution, where a scheduled JCL job orchestrates the execution of a core billing program to produce invoices on a monthly cycle. The application is structured to handle the end-to-end invoicing workflow, ensuring customers receive accurate and timely billing statements. Its design reflects a traditional mainframe-based architecture commonly used in industries requiring reliable, high-volume batch billing operations.
